verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents spend analysis by cost center, user and expense category, and says payments can appear already categorized by area, owner and expense type. Its API also covers card and bank statements, categories, cost centers and suppliers for classifying spend. Nothing states that transactions show up in real time or on the same day, and merchant-level breakdown is only implied through supplier classification. Missing for 10: explicit real-time or same-day transaction visibility, merchant-level spend reporting, team dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
